utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Got it — 8am at the church parking lot, Monday and Wednesday for sure, and Friday if it works out. Thanks for keeping me straight on it!

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Of course — I’ll send a quick reminder if anything changes. Thanks again for being on it!

utterances.speaker: Mara

utterances.speaker: Mina
